fusions.name: Tangleroot
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt into the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 damage and making it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds, with a 40% chance of [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Seedfall Ring
fusions.desc: Hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage to each plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, stunning it for 0.8 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Growing Gait
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Deep Roots
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%. It also regenerates 1 health a second, permanently.
